name: Jungle Speed

categories.label: Emptied all cards first (winner)
categories.hint: First player with no cards in both draw and face-up piles wins.

notes: family: race (first to get rid of all cards). No points. Official rules: object is to get rid of all your cards; a player who plays their last draw-pile card has not won until the face-up pile in front of them is also gone. A player whose last card is an All Play card wins immediately and leaves the pot; play continues until two remain. Rulebook also lists optional 2-player and other variants (not modelled).
winCondition: First player to be rid of all cards (draw pile and face-up pile) wins; a player whose last card is an All Play card wins immediately.

sources.title: Jungle Speed rules (Asmodee, English, 2003)
sources.section: Aim of the Game; End of the Game; Special Cases (All Play last card)

endCondition.description: Game ends when only two players remain after others have emptied their cards, or when a first player empties; the first to empty wins.
